notes.title: ⏳ Countdown to Release! 🚀
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/e5dbb1905869af120750b7fcd426e3a5b63bd76d.png

Hello 🤠. Mycelium Heaven comes out in a week!
So, I’m doing the countdown wizard-style. Starting tomorrow, you’ll have a mini mushroom-and-zombie-themed puzzle to solve before the release.
Can you solve them all?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/385fed83a2aa313f1e2a2b895eb26d3d9ef69e81.png

🌲As promised, first riddle!🌲
🧟Can you separate the zombies from the mushrooms by drawing 3 straight lines?🧟
🍄Let me know if you solved it! See you tomorrow with a new little puzzle 🍄

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/f3138474d897bd54c5a4eaa106557504365d8778.png
💀New day, new puzzle!💀
🍄Can make the musroom reach its nutricious food?🍄
🍃Share this with that friend that would like to solve this in a bathroom break!🍃

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/59d195469e486489e87c5b5c208d927a0696bbe4.png
🍄Third puzzle, just 3 more to go🍄
🧟Can you help our purple fungi eat the roaming zombie?🧟
💀See you tomorrow with more brain teasing zombie eating!💀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/4b8aeb4f271e924f5059b76d1f00db3add08dd5a.png
🌲4th puzzle is all about twisting🌲
💀Can you connect the mushroom to the skull rotating only two tiles?💀
🧟Did you solve it? Tomorrow more little puzzles🧟

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/72fe2675e126e55912cfbbdc6236ad1c6113ba67.png
🏕️The 5th puzzle and the biggest one🏕️
🍄Can you connect all of the mushrooms with all of the skulls?🍄
🍂Tomorrow the last little puzzle!🍂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/e013e4a3c0083bae3def8336a6a515386425b555.png
🍄Mycelium Heaven comes out tomorrow, so this is the last one!🍄
🍂Can you leave an even number of mushrooms by removing 6 of them?🍂 💀If you got them all right, you are a certified mushroom of the apocalypse, congratulations!💀

notes.title: ✨🛠️Demo Update! (Alpha 1.5.0)🛠️✨
notes.notes:
Howdy! 🤠

I know I said I wasn't going to update the demo anymore, but I added some juicy things and I couldn't resist. And with the Next Fest coming it was the perfect oportunity. 
Here is what's new:

 Cool squishy animations for the tiles and zombies
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/3e1bde07761e68427b2938f09da2a2d67ec597f0.gif
 An exit button!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/160b8aea3998a0ee2b2dbfb57e78c1065503f540.png
 Camera movement
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/d4bc65ecf6c834b7e2068a59ad6967508ba49883.gif
 Some levels were reorganised and tweaked
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/a63dcac2e7f451071d587fbf222a55e0cab65b7a.png
 Bug fixing

 Sounds not playing
 Zombies not rewinding properly
 Random stuff I created while adding new things for the spring mechanics


I hope this things make the experience better and that you like it. 
As always, if you want to follow the development closer you can come by my Twitter or TikTok and even say hi 🙆. 

See you next time!

notes.title: Alpha 1.4.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hi !🙆‍♂️🧙‍♂️

Once again, all of the feedback is being super useful, so thank you very much 🤗. I want the game to be as readable as possible because the challenge has to come from the puzzles, not from not knowing what's going on.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/51187d9d7f55581f7cde9b2aed521ada9a47eee6.png
Here is a little list of what changed:


 Tiles now have a border!
   - Active tiles have a thick border so you don't depend on brightness only to see them. The contrast of the basic tile has been increased, and a new thinner border added so they stand out more on every floor.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/548317ae8ac87ed1255dcb4086b9834e48ed7cfb.gif
 Easier to read graves
   - Numbers on graves now have a white border. They are also a little bit tilted to face the camera.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/974696f2819dec80136b687ceb4c66ad53ade9bf.png
 Meet Obo🎃
   - The first easter egg! If you say hi to our dumb little friend in the menu; he will jiggle and bounce.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/27f7378d3a31bbf8530e074e8ba47ec3b9d07c64.gif


I have also been working on getting the game in the Play Store, and it was hard but things are working out! I'm going to start making the two new seasons soon, so this is probably the last demo update. 
We'll see each other when the game releases, but if you want to keep up with every little thing going on in the development (I might have an oversharing problem), you can tag along on X or TikTok (@3DGoblinDev).

Take care and have a nice holiday season! 🤙

notes.title: Alpha 1.3.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!🤠 

The demo has been updated! I have been taking feedback from you guys and it has been very useful. I will be adjusting what the game already has before moving on with more levels. For now, this are the current changes:

Fixed rewind bug 
   - The bug caused tiles with a body to rewind into a zombie when it had steped on them. The rewind system has been improved to avoid that type of bugs.
Sound control
    - Added buttons to control music and sfx
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/363a21a9ea1d56f7faa50abf42f0a9cb451557ee.png
Transitions and level selector
    - Added seasonal transitions to access all level selectors
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709654/53c58387b267363e87c38dcc6208e7f90b8b60ba.gif

If you want to leave any feedback or suggestion please feel free to do so! You can do it at @3DGoblinDev on Twitter. 
Thanks to all of you guys who submitted feedback or reported bugs I really appreceate it! 🤗

See you around!
